name: HOP Energy
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public hopenergy.com pages (home, My Account Portal, Energy Costs & Plans FAQs) and the public portal page hopenergyonline.com/hopenergy; no sign-in, no enrollment, no forms submitted. Portal page: 'Customer Login' with 'Remember me' and 'Forgot Password?'; new users enroll with the 12-digit account number plus the phone number on the account ('Enroll Now'). The sign-in field label is not rendered in the public text; the portal is the same vendor product Eastern Propane uses (email + password), so email is modelled as inferred. Portal features: order history, current and past payments, online bill payment, service requests, text notifications, AutoPay and paperless billing. Fixed and capped price plans and a budget plan are arranged through the local office; customers having trouble paying contact their branch's customer service department; state energy assistance typically opens in early November. Phones: service 833-837-7690, sales/new customers 866-395-7220, service requests 888-835-3535. No guest payment, fees, late charges or closing steps are published on the pages used. Review 2026-10-10: 833-837-7690 is listed as Service / Customer Support Requests on the Contact Us page (no dedicated billing line is published), so help wording says Customer Support rather than billing.

guest_pay.note: Online payments are made in the My Account portal. New users enroll with their 12-digit account number and the phone number on the account, or call 833-837-7690.

help.title: My Account portal
paragraphs: Pay your HOP Energy bill online in the secure My Account portal. The portal also shows your order history and current and past payments, lets you request a non-emergency service call, and sends text notifications about deliveries, payments and account updates.
For account questions call HOP Energy Customer Support at 833-837-7690.
steps: Open My Account and log in.
Select a payment method and amount.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Set up AutoPay in the My Account portal and your payments are processed automatically.

help.title: Enroll in My Account
paragraphs: To enroll, enter your 12-digit HOP Energy account number and the phone number associated with the account, then choose Enroll Now and finish setting up your sign-in.

help.title: Price plans and help paying
paragraphs: HOP Energy offers fixed and capped price plans, and a budget plan that spreads heating costs across the year. Your local office has the details; expiring plans get a renewal notice and can be renewed by phone, at the office or in My Account.
If you are having trouble paying, contact your local branch's customer service department to discuss payment options. State energy assistance programs usually open in early November.

extra.intent: Using the HOP Energy website's help pages, find the Customer Support phone number. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
